metadata.title: Massive runaway stars in the Small Magellanic Cloud

notes: No eligible stars. The paper identifies a dozen SMC field OB stars as bow-shock-producing runaways, but the evidence concerns supersonic motion and ejection from local SMC clusters/associations, not present-day unbound status relative to the Milky Way; no Galactic escape criterion is stated or shown to be satisfied (T:p1-b7, T:p3-b2, T:p3-b3, T:p5-b7, T:p5-b9). SMC-WR3 (AzV 60a) is only discussed as possibly showing a bow shock or circumstellar nebula and likewise is not claimed to be Galactic-unbound (T:p4-b6, T:p5-b2).
